entries.title: Business Context
entries.summary: Banks maintain large customer databases accumulated over years. The same customer may have been onboarded multiple times under slightly different names, addresses, or using partial identity documents. These duplicate records create compliance risks, inflate AML alert volumes, and complicate regulatory reporting. The De-Duplication Screening module enables compliance officers and analysts to identify such duplicate records by systematically comparing KYC parameters across the customer base. The m

bullets.text: Banks maintain large customer databases accumulated over years
The same customer may have been onboarded multiple times under slightly different names, addresses, or using partial identity documents
These duplicate records create compliance risks, inflate AML alert volumes, and complicate regulatory reporting
The De-Duplication Screening module enables compliance officers and analysts to identify such duplicate records by systematically comparing KYC parameters across the customer base
The module is positioned within the Sanction Screening section of the Clari5 AML platform

entries.title: Duplicate Matching Logic
entries.summary: Two customer records are grouped as duplicates if they share an identical value for at least one selected match parameter. Multiple parameters can match simultaneously; all matched parameters are displayed in the Match Parameters column. The Match Score reflects the percentage of selected parameters that match between the two records. Records with Account Status of "Closed" may still appear in duplicate groups for historical compliance tracking.
